gloss: person who likes to help others; meddlesome person

definitions.gloss: person who likes to help others; someone who enjoys taking care of others
definitions.explanation: a person who naturally tends to help and take care of people around them
someone who interferes in others' affairs, often unwanted (negative nuance)

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧ (care/help) + {好|ず}き (liking/fond of)

USAGE:
Can be positive (caring, helpful) or negative (meddlesome, nosy) depending on context. When excessive, it can be seen as ⟦お{節介|せっかい}→お節介：07309_osekkai⟧ (unsolicited interference).

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can be used as a noun or a na-adjective:
- {世話好|せわず}きな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ - a helpful/meddlesome person
- {世話好|せわず}き⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧ - to like helping others

SIMILAR ～{好|ず}き COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{甘党|あまとう}→甘党：08339_amatou⟧/⟦{辛党|からとう}→辛党：08340_karatou⟧ - person who likes sweets/spicy food
- ⟦お{人好|ひとよ}し→お人好し：27207_ohitoyoshi⟧ - good-natured person
- ⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧{見|み}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ - takes good care of others
